content_mode_evidence: The sampled reel shows her own renovated kitchen ('Love this kitchen with my whole heart… I wrote a whole blog post on all our design decisions with a list of everything we used'). The blog documents real renovation projects (farmhouse, guest cottage, makeovers) with photographer credits (e.g. 'Photos by Kaitlin Green'). No AI signals were seen.
niche_focus: Interior styling, home renovation (farmhouse and guest cottage) and makeovers, run as a design-media brand (blog, book, TV) with shoppable sources
cta_pattern: 'link in my bio' sends viewers to long-form blog posts with full source lists. The blog monetizes that traffic through LTK affiliate links, the 'SHOP OUR FAVORITE FINDS' shop page, sponsored posts that disclose partners and display ads, and captures emails with the newsletter and 'GET OUR FREE 4-DAY GUIDE'. Community hashtags #showemyourstyled and #showemyourdiy appear in the bio.
